Question: I want to ask you that in most of the time i see in my dream that I am flying above the ground level it is such that in my dream I start believing that I have power to fly above the ground level when ever I apply much force I fly much more fast and much more high. Answer ID: 7454 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1632/1401=B/1429) You suffer from stomach problems i.e. indigestion. Get a treatment. It is meaningless and nonsense dream. Such dreams come due to problems in stomach. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
